units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:8:9">Y. Pes. VIII, end, 36ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ היו שומרין וכ׳</he> (Roman) soldiers were guarding the doors of the Temple in Jerus., and they bathed (as the ceremony of admission into Judaism), and on the same evening partook of the Passover meal. [<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 7:13">Tosef. ib. VII, 13</cite>, <he>איצטרדיות</he> ed. Zuck., Var. <he>אצטדריוטות</he>, <he>שחרדיו׳</he>.]
